source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: This model's melee attacks get +1 to **[Hit rolls](vsdata:core-rule/hit-rolls)** against a unit under its **[Starting Strength](vsdata:core-rule/units-and-models)**, and also +1 to **[Wound rolls](vsdata:core-rule/wound-rolls)** if that unit has dropped **Below Half-strength**.

combat.unresolved: Withheld as a class: the last two independent reviews found 10 of 300 sampled combat readings of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, not under the 2% this reading may ship with.
